name: PantoSource for WooCommerce
author: PantoSource

sections.description:
Coming soon.

We’re putting the finishing touches on this listing. Full details, setup instructions, and screenshots will be published shortly.

In the meantime, if you have questions, please reach out via the support tab.

Privacy Policy

This plugin transmits WooCommerce event data — including page URLs, product details, order values, and hashed customer signals — to the PantoSource platform operated by Panto Martech LLC.

Data is used solely for ad attribution and conversion tracking on behalf of the store owner. PantoSource does not sell personal data to third parties.

For full details, please review:

  • PantoSource Privacy Policy
  • PantoSource GDPR Documentation
  • Data Processing Agreement (DPA)
  • Sub-Processors
sections.changelog:
1.0.10

Directory listing update.

1.0.9

  • Security: frontend rate-limit transient is now keyed on the server-observed IP only, preventing client-controlled keys from flooding transients or bypassing the limit
  • Prefix all plugin transients with pantosource_ (dedupe, rate-limit, customer-updated) to avoid collisions with other plugins
  • Rename the custom one-minute cron schedule to pantosource_minute (was the generic “minute”) to avoid cron_schedules collisions; existing installs migrate automatically

1.0.8

  • Plugin Check PHPCS: document cart quantity array sanitization after verified WooCommerce cart nonce

1.0.7

  • Plugin Check PHPCS cleanup: remove unused POST JSON helper; verify WooCommerce cart nonce before reading cart quantities

1.0.6

  • Plugin Check remediation: release packaging excludes dotfiles and dev markdown
  • Input PHPCS compliance for cookies, cart POST detection, and AJAX JSON decode paths
  • Remove manual load_plugin_textdomain() for WordPress.org auto-translation

1.0.5

  • Declare compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)

1.0.4

  • WordPress Plugin Review remediation: structured input sanitization for cookies, POST JSON, and order meta
  • Replaced PHP sessions with consent-gated marketing cookies for session id and server landing URL (cache-friendly)
  • Added Requires Plugins: woocommerce header and WooCommerce-guarded initialization
  • Text domain aligned to pantosource-for-woocommerce; load_plugin_textdomain() on plugins_loaded
  • Registered pantosource_session_id and pantosource_server_landing_url with WP Consent API

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Server-side event tracking for WooCommerce (Page View, View Product, Product Search, Sign Up, Login/Logout, Add to Cart, Initiate Checkout, Purchase)
  • API key authentication with PantoSource
  • Real-time event delivery to the PantoSource platform
